scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && npm run build && cp *.js *.css ../server/public/ && find . -maxdepth 1 -name '*.html' ! -name 'index.html' -exec cp {} ../server/public/ \; && find . -maxdepth 1 \( -name '*.png' -o -name '*.PNG' \) -exec cp {} ../server/public/ \;
